title: Association of Thoraco-mediastinal Radiotherapy With Maintenance Immunotherapy Treatment With Atezolizumab
official: Lung Microcytoma Extensive Disease: Prospective Study of Association of Thoraco-mediastinal Radiotherapy With Maintenance Immunotherapy Treatment With Atezolizumab
summary: Investigate the role of consolidative radiotherapy treatment at the thoraco-mediastinal level in the patient suffering from lung microcytoma - extensive disease and treated with chemo-immunotherapy with atezolizumab, in association with maintenance therapy with atezolizumab.
